repair_reason: CL1 checked SAFE(state) under safety-policy rollout but counted admitted transitions as if all actions from SAFE states were admissible.
state_action_space_description: Exhaustive finite pair set: 17500 CL1 states times 5 actions = 87500 (state, action) pairs.
transition_semantics: The CL1 deterministic transition is reused unchanged. AID_i increases zone i and costs mass; CONSERVE restores mass; the phase-indexed exogenous shock damages one zone; failed zones drain mass; phase advances modulo 4.
collapse_predicate: Collapse if at least two zones have health <= 0 (spread mechanism) or if mass <= 0 (mass mechanism). The predicate is audit-only.
learner_visible_transition: observe(state), action, observe(successor). Observations contain zones, mass, and phase only. No collapse labels, future outcomes, mechanisms, witness classes, or reporting-only metrics are learner-visible.
candidate_admission_rule: ADMIT(state, action) is true iff the source is not already collapsed, the successor transition(state, action) is not already collapsed, and rollout from the successor under the CL1 deterministic safety policy remains non-collapse for horizon - 1.
continuation_policy: CL1 deterministic safety_policy. CL1.1 tests one-step action admission followed by safety-policy continuation; it does not prove safety under arbitrary future learner actions.

metrics.unsafe_admitted_transition_rate: P(full collapse within horizon after taking action | ADMIT(state, action) = true)
metrics.already_collapsed_source_admitted_rate: P(source state already collapsed | ADMIT(state, action) = true)
metrics.already_collapsed_successor_admitted_rat: P(successor state already collapsed | ADMIT(state, action) = true)
metrics.false_positive_action_rate: P(ADMIT(state, action) = false | action transition remains safe within horizon)
metrics.equal_volume_possible: Whether action-conditioned admitted ledger can match the declared minimum transition volume and unfiltered control budget

downstream_halt_rule: No learner training, no LLM scaling, and no derivability claim unless decision is ACTION-LEDGER-OK.
provenance_attestation: This preregistration file was written before final CL1.1 metric computation. Thresholds must not be moved after seeing results.
